trkplay
-------

Plays Spectrum tracker music on the AY: ProTracker 3 (.pt3, also Vortex
Tracker II modules), Sound Tracker (.stc) and SQ Tracker (.sqt). It replaces
the separate playpt3, playstc and playsqt commands.

Usage:

	.trkplay file

The name goes in quotes when it has spaces or a drive name, for example

	.trkplay "My Song.pt3"
	.trkplay "hd1:/music/tune.stc"

A PT3 is recognised by its header, whatever its extension. An STC or SQT by
its extension (.stc, .sqt). Any other file gives "Unknown module type".

While it plays it shows "Playing:" and the song's title (a PT3's title, an
STC's name), or the file's name when the song has none (always for an SQT).
Under it come a PT3's author and tracker version, or the tracker's name, and
a meter for each of the three channels, drawn in block graphics:

	A:##########
	B:####
	C:#######

SPACE (BREAK) stops it. The song is loaded into the Spectrum's free memory
(between the BASIC program and the stack), so a very large file or a large
BASIC program can give "Out of memory".

The players are from Trackerplayer 0.1 by Matt Westcott (gasman), 2010:
the Vortex Tracker II PT3 player by Sergey Bulba and disassemblies of the
Sound Tracker and SQ Tracker players. trkplay puts them in one command.
